sections.body: This handbook explains how the demo team works. Start with [[onboarding#first-week]], then read [[release-process#steps]].

Current work is tracked on the demo board.

[DEMO board](inferops://demo.local/project/board/DEMO)

Ask in the team channel before moving a card you do not own.

1. Freeze the release branch.
2. Run the full test suite.
3. Tag the release and publish the notes.

The release checklist lives on the board, see [the DEMO board](inferops://demo.local/project/board/DEMO) for open items.
In your first week, pair with a teammate on one small issue and read [[handbook#purpose]].
